title: $p$-adic multiple $L$-functions and twisted multiple Bernoulli numbers
summary: We compute the special values ($p$MLFVs) of the $p$-adic multiple $L$-functions introduced by Furusho, Komori, Matsumoto, and Tsumura at tuples of positive integers. Furusho and Jarossay show that the special values can be expressed as an infinite sum of cyclotomic multiple harmonic values (CMHVs) with coefficients given by cyclotomic multiple Bernoulli numbers (CMBNs).
